verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API-first banking platform, so it can be driven headlessly. Per the docs, API keys issued in Sandbox can call the APIs immediately, and webhooks push events to integrators. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published, and sandbox test cases support scripted verification flows. However, nothing shows a CLI, SDKs, or CI-specific guidance, so automation means building raw HTTP integrations yourself. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless tooling, documented CI/CD integration patterns, SDKs, independent hands-on corroboration.
